turns.assistant_response: Sorry about that—when the app locks you out for not confirming your identity, do you mean you’re getting an “identity verification failed/can’t confirm who you are” message, or are you being asked to complete identity checks and then it stops?

turns.user_utterance: It’s the first thing—just a “can’t confirm who I am” error and I’m locked out.
turns.assistant_response:
Thanks—if you’re seeing a “can’t confirm who I am” error and getting locked out, that points to an identity-verification failure. Try again after a short wait, and make sure the details you submitted match your ID exactly (spelling, address, and date of birth). Also double-check your connection and that any document/photo uploads are clear and not blurry or cut off. 

To narrow it down: are you currently able to access the identity check page at all, or does it lock you out immediately before you can start?
